categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Alltest Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of rapid diagnostic reagents. Its product portfolio includes six major series: drugs and substance abuse detection, infectious disease detection, women's health detection, tumor marker detection, cardiac marker detection, and other diagnostic reagents. The company also produces biochemical diagnostic reagents, immunofluorescence reagents, chemiluminescence reagents, electronic instruments, biosensor electrochemical products, and molecular diagnostics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed eight core technology platforms including biological raw materials, POCT rapid diagnostic technology, biochemical technology, chemiluminescence technology, electronic instrument technology, immunoblotting technology, molecular diagnostics, and biosensor electrochemical technology. Key proprietary technologies include monoclonal antibody preparation, nano-scale immunogold labeling, time-resolved immunofluorescence, dry chemistry analysis, and electrochemical biosensors. Production strictly follows medical device and IVD reagent quality standards with comprehensive quality control from raw materials to finished products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers include overseas medical device brand owners and manufacturers, hospitals, pharmacies, national laboratories, law enforcement, military, and customs agencies. Its products serve clinical diagnostics, on-site testing, personal health management, and veterinary markets. The overseas market accounts for over 90% of sales, with products sold in more than 170 countries and regions. ODM sales dominate overseas, while domestic sales focus on self-branded products with domestic registration certificates.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hangzhou Alltest Biotech operates globally with a strong presence in over 170 countries and regions. Key markets include Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and other international regions. The company has subsidiaries and branches in China, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, Hong Kong, and Spain, supporting its global sales and service network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and related instruments. It has strong upstream capabilities in biological raw material research and production, achieving over 80% self-supply rate for key raw materials such as antigens and antibodies, reducing reliance on imports and enhancing cost competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with continuous R&D investment, focusing on expanding product lines and developing new technologies such as AI-assisted diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, biosensors, and POCT platforms. It aims to maintain monthly new product launches, enhance product quality, and expand into emerging markets including pet healthcare and home diagnostics. The company also prioritizes compliance with evolving regulatory standards like the EU IVDR and strengthens intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of IVD products, including rapid diagnostic reagents and related instruments. The company employs an ODM business model for overseas sales, complemented by self-branded product sales domestically. Revenue streams include product sales to medical institutions, government agencies, and commercial customers globally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hangzhou Alltest Biotech is a leading player in the global POCT segment of the IVD industry, competing with international giants such as Roche, Abbott, Danaher, and Siemens in high-end fields like chemiluminescence and molecular diagnostics. The company holds a strong competitive position in drug and substance abuse detection and infectious disease testing, with several globally leading and first-to-market products. Its extensive product portfolio and global market penetration provide a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 866.6 million, representing a 14.83% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose 67.5% to RMB 302.5 million. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 4.19 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.88 billion. R&D investment accounted for 11.06% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive and diversified product portfolio with over 1,400 types of rapid diagnostic reagents, addressing a wide range of clinical and on-site testing needs. Its strong in-house biological raw material capabilities ensure product quality, cost advantages, and supply stability. The company emphasizes innovation, rapid product development, and regulatory compliance, delivering accurate, reliable, and user-friendly diagnostic solutions globally. Its global sales network and ODM model enable broad market access and customer diversification.
